query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_enrichies,
       COUNT(plant_id) as avec_plante,
       COUNT(extraction_method_id) as avec_methode,
       COUNT(olfactive_family) as avec_famille,
       COUNT(olfactive_profile) as avec_profil
FROM raw_materials 
WHERE material_id LIKE 'RM_%'
AND created_at >= '2026-03-10 13:00:00';
